description: This PHP source file defines the SuiteEditorConnector class, which manages different HTML editors for user preferences in SuiteCRM, including methods for retrieving editor settings and rendering the editor HTML based on user preferences.

classes.name: SuiteEditorConnector
classes.description: A class that provides methods to get editor settings and generate HTML for different user-selected editors in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getSuiteSettings
methods.description: Generates configuration settings for the TinyMCE editor, including setup scripts and dimensions.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML output for the user’s preferred editor, based on user preferences, and renders it using Smarty templates.
